environment.scope: Repository-only / DARK / default-OFF / migration-free. Implements the pkt-127 conservative bounded-cohort operating model for ADR-0107 established-account monitoring recovery WITHOUT enabling anything in production. Adds: (1) a governed, file-based, mutually-exclusive OPERATIONAL LEASE (hosted_workspace/recovery_lease.py) with owner/purpose/correlation-id/created/expiry, bounded TTL, fail-closed acquisition, safe EXPIRED reclaim, MALFORMED fail-closed, no-secret audit log — deploy and recovery leases are mutually exclusive; (2) a Django-free deploy gate (scripts/deploy_recovery_gate.py) that refuses a backend deploy while a recovery lease is live (works when the backend is down) with an audited emergency override; (3) config hardening in liveness_recovery.py: recovery_config_metadata() (safe, NO env dump), _is_approved_steady_state_config() (allow-list<=1 + breaker 1/1 + clean >=300s threshold), and recovery_enablement_warnings() emitted every cron cycle when recovery is enabled without an active governed lease and not an approved steady-state shape (plus LIVE-requires-allow-list and malformed warnings); the 300s stale floor was already enforced; (4) a bounded acceptance runner (hosted_workspace/recovery_acceptance.py run_bounded_acceptance) whose finally block ALWAYS restores the byte-exact beta.env baseline, recreates the backend, confirms both recovery flags OFF, and releases the lease — a teardown failure alerts and leaves the lease to self-expire, never silently leaving flags enabled; host wrapper scripts/recovery_acceptance_runner.py. NO deploy, NO flag enablement, NO host/MT5 contact, NO terminal relaunch, NO snapshot, NO is_active change, NO Copy-Trading, NO broker action.

expected_results: Governed lease: a deploy action is blocked while a recovery lease is live, and vice versa; only one lease is live at a time; an EXPIRED lease is not blocking and is reclaimable; a MALFORMED/empty lease fails closed (blocks, never read as ABSENT); release only by matching correlation; acquire over an expired lease reclaims and succeeds; TTL is clamped to [60,7200]; acquire/release/reclaim/override are audited; secret-bearing free-text fields are rejected and redacted.

Deploy gate (Django-free): classifies identically to recovery_lease (agreement test); exits 2 when blocked, 0 when clear; an --emergency-override proceeds (exit 0) and writes an audit record; a missing lease-file path fails closed.

Config hardening: a 299s threshold is rejected (fail-closed to 900, malformed=True) and a 300s threshold is accepted; a missing/empty/malformed allow-list yields zero candidates; LIVE recovery without an allow-list warns; the approved steady-state validator is True only for enabled + allow-list<=1 + breaker 1/1 + clean threshold; recovery enabled without an active lease and not an approved shape warns LEFTOVER every cycle; the config metadata is safe (no environment dump, no secret).

Bounded acceptance runner: success / FAIL / timeout / exception ALL restore the byte-exact baseline, confirm flags OFF, and release the lease (finally); a run blocked by a live deploy lease never arms; a teardown that cannot confirm flags OFF marks teardown_ok False and raises an operator alert.
Preserved invariants (DB): only the allow-listed account is relaunched and siblings are unchanged; a Copy-Trading participant is excluded even if listed; is_active is never mutated by recovery.
No secret/environment leakage: lease fields, audit log, and config metadata carry no secret; manage.py check clean; makemigrations --check migration-free; secret scan + evidence lint clean.
